title: Token & prompt playground
summary: Local-model experiments with token budgets, streaming and validated JSON output.
description: A Next.js developer tool for composing prompts, inspecting token usage and comparing streaming and normal responses. Structured responses are checked with Zod, while PostgreSQL and Prisma retain runs, usage and errors for comparison.
scope: Prompt composition, token counting and history summarisation.
Streaming and normal response modes with cancellation handling.
Structured-output parsing and schema validation.
PostgreSQL-backed run history via Prisma.
imageAlt: Illustrated prompt and structured-output cover for the token playground.

title: Finance Tracker
summary: AI extraction and OCR for PDF statements, with a review step before saving transactions.
description: A self-hosted Python API that extracts statement text, falls back to OCR for scanned PDFs and sends the extracted content to a selected AI provider. Separate upload, review/confirmation and transaction-query endpoints keep extraction and persistence distinct.
scope: Text-based PDF extraction and OCR fallback.
OpenAI and Anthropic provider paths.
Review and confirmation before transaction storage.
Transaction queries and cached submissions.
imageAlt: Illustrated PDF-to-transactions cover for Finance Tracker.

title: API Starter
summary: An Express API foundation with authentication, validation, MongoDB and API tests.
description: A modular Node.js API starter separating routes, controllers, services and database access. It includes JWT authentication, user validation, password hashing, request logging, error handling and a test suite for user operations.
scope: User registration, login and authenticated profile routes.
Validation, password hashing and data-transfer mapping.
Database adapter and test database support.
Request logging and container configuration.
imageAlt: Illustrated route diagram cover for API Starter.

title: Telegram mini-app
summary: A Telegram frontend, bot/server and transaction interface connected in one project.
description: A three-part integration combining a Next.js Telegram Mini App, a Node.js bot/server and a browser-based transaction interface. The server provides route generation and WebSocket updates for the frontend.
scope: Telegram Mini App frontend and SDK integration.
Bot/server route generation and socket communication.
A separate interface for EVM approvals, minting and bridging.
imageAlt: Telegram-branded cover for the Omnichain mini-app.

title: Contest leaderboard API
summary: A FastAPI backend for contest participation, report scoring and ELO history.
description: A Python API with authentication, contest participation, SQLAlchemy data models and an ELO service for weighted report scoring. The repository includes tests for authentication, sign-up and rating calculations.
scope: Contest and participation endpoints.
Severity-weighted ratings and ELO history.
Authentication and rating test modules.

title: Self-hosted Compose
summary: A Docker Compose collection for media, networking, storage and everyday self-hosted services.
description: A collection of service-specific Docker Compose configurations, with setup instructions for running and adapting individual stacks. It brings together tools for media, DNS filtering, reverse proxies, file storage and container management.
imageAlt: Illustrated service containers connected in a self-hosted stack.
scope: Individual Compose configurations for media, storage and networking services.
Reverse-proxy, DNS filtering and container-management configurations.
Repository instructions for deploying and customising a service.

title: Tweet Fetcher
summary: Scheduled tweet collection with participant tracking and exports to Google Sheets and Excel.
description: A TypeScript automation script that retrieves tweets matching a coding-challenge query, resolves their authors and records participant activity. It handles paginated results, updates Google Sheets and exports to Excel. The source targets the Twitter API; live operation depends on current API access and configuration.
imageAlt: Illustrated message stream collected into a spreadsheet for Tweet Fetcher.
scope: Paginated tweet search and author lookup.
Participant activity tracking and spreadsheet updates.
Scheduled runs and Excel export.
